title: ws80211: Add support for EHT 320MHz monitor modes via nl80211
description:
Add support for configuring 320Mhz monitor modes via nl80211. This
should work on the command line with dumpcap; support via the
Wireless toolbar is not implemented.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -300,10 +300,10 @@ Set the channel on the interface; this is supported only on IEEE
 802.11 Wi-Fi interfaces, and supported only on some operating systems.
 
 __freq__ is the frequency of the channel.  __type__ is the type of the
-channel, for 802.11n and 802.11ac.  The values for __type__ are
+channel for 802.11n and later.  The values for __type__ are
 --
 
-NOHT:: Used for non-802.11n/non-802.1ac channels
+NOHT:: Used for 802.11b/g channels
 
 HT20:: 20 MHz channel
 
@@ -319,6 +319,8 @@ the center frequencies of the two channels
 
 VHT160:: 160 MHz channel, with __centerfreq1__ as its center frequency
 
+EHT320:: 320 MHz channel, with __centerfreq1__ as its center frequency
+
 -L|--list-data-link-types::
 List the data link types supported by the interface and exit. The reported
 link types can be used for the *-y* option.

@@ -225,6 +225,9 @@
 /* VHT_CAPABILITY is supported */
 #cmakedefine HAVE_NL80211_VHT_CAPABILITY 1
 
+/* EHT_CAPABILITY is supported */
+#cmakedefine HAVE_NL80211_EHT_CAPABILITY 1
+
 /* Define to 1 if you have macOS frameworks */
 #cmakedefine HAVE_MACOS_FRAMEWORKS 1
